dataPalettes.meaning: Tracked-sample share counts distinct individuals in the selected period. Observation heat counts unique records against the selected species’ full-period sample before filtering months; neither estimates abundance.

accessibility.focus: 2px pale outline with 5–6px offset; native select has focus-within wrapper.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Home starts on a still poster; no stamp tilt, density/observation crossfade or atlas-panel, atlas-bird or collection arrival animation. LivingBirdFilm requires manual Play, including post-action flight, with an 80ms video reveal. Night ambient fade shortens to 80ms. Night stage and earned-stamp arrival animations are omitted.
accessibility.touch: No pointer tilt; touch hint replaces movement hint.
accessibility.journey: Action checkboxes and a separate after-dark confirmation gate the reward. Starting or advancing focuses the next heading; mobile scrolls it into view. Begin tonight is also present in the first mobile introduction.
accessibility.film: Muted inline footage with Play/Pause and poster fallback, pausing offscreen or when hidden. The post-action modal focuses Reveal tonight’s bird, supports Escape and keeps the bird concealed until reveal; skipping does not undo the recorded action.
accessibility.atlas: A shared native species select with previous/next buttons and a native 1–12 month range work in both scopes. Place search is non-modal; Escape closes it and restores trigger focus. Geolocation is requested only by activating Near home.

scope.legacy: Six original quiz pages remain archived and unrouted. Old bookmarks and journal entries are preserved without grants; quiz flags do not unlock the earned collection.

journeys.mapContext: One month/layer URL model supports both scopes and validated local returnTo links through profiles, gallery and Lights Out. Legacy nearbyMonth/nearbyLayer are normalized. A location-less view=nearby link opens place search without requesting geolocation.
journeys.nearby: Near home explicitly requests approximate geolocation and moves the existing map. Find a place / Change place opens a non-modal city search panel. The shared bird chooser, month range and opacity filter the loaded 25km sample without refitting or requerying. Back to migration restores the preceding historical bird and retains month.
journeys.collection: Twenty earnable stamps: seven illustrated and thirteen licensed photographic. All / Unlocked / Locked filters, dated earned states and a keyboard carousel. Locked paper stays sealed; unlocked stamps expose four cosmetic finishes. Free field notes and map links remain available, with earlier favourites as separate bookmarks.
journeys.lightsOut: Mystery bird, explicit after-dark action, real eight-second flight, species reveal, earned stamp, bird information. Identity remains concealed during the ritual until action and film/reveal. The record precedes playback; Reveal tonight’s bird, Escape, pause and replay remain available. Mobile Begin tonight starts from the first introduction.

observationHeat.denominator: Selected species’ unique valid records across the full source period, unchanged by month filters.
observationHeat.rendering: Finite local kernel with latitude-corrected longitudinal support, screen compositing and pearl isobands. No minimum pixel radius on zoom-out. Switch to original points for record provenance.

films.identity: Exact species is not established by original filenames. Shared or unverified archival footage is labelled independently from profile/data identity.
films.profileLayout: Desktop directional reading mask leaves the subject visible; mobile uses a separate 390px film strip after the introduction. Stamps follow below.
films.lightsOutLayout: The scoped .lights-hero > .lights-landscape-film rule holds the film as an absolute background independent of shared film CSS load order.

mapControls.bird: One native species selector, previous/next controls, available stamp, save/profile/collection links. Nearby options come from the chosen area’s source records.
mapControls.month: One native January–December range with twelve labels, All months and play/pause, shared on desktop/mobile and between scopes.
mapControls.location: Place selection changes the existing map centre and observation sample. Nearby species, month and opacity retain viewport and loaded sample.
mapControls.permission: Near home calls geolocation only after explicit activation; place search and remembered-area selection do not request it.

nightRewards.assignment: One earliest immutable assignment per retained local calendar date, preferring eligible species not yet earned. Assignment is prepared only when the ritual begins.
nightRewards.earning: At least one real action and explicit after-dark confirmation; one earned record per date, shared across ritual/gallery/profile/map. A stale pre-midnight confirmation cannot earn the next date.
nightRewards.undo: Removing a night revokes its reward, while retaining the assignment to prevent reroll. A species stays unlocked if another retained date earned it.
nightRewards.storage: Browser-local ledger with deterministic cross-tab merge and shared visit-only fallback. Old bookmarks, quiz flags and journal entries never grant rewards. Clearing site data removes local history.
nightRewards.discovery: Optional NightAreaPicker uses exact catalog scientific names present in actual nearby records from the same calendar month. Missing matches or unavailable area data use a labelled global discovery. Evidence inspires the reward; it is never an overhead forecast.

photography.use: Named-species Commons photographs in perforated paper stamps, with visible creator, original source, CC license and crop disclosure. Separate from seven illustrations and archival film identity.

dataCoverage.meaning: Three telemetry species and seventeen independent-observation species; small monthly global/Australian samples are not abundance estimates or forecasts.

narrative.overview:
BirdRadar places oversized, closely set sans-serif type and quiet controls directly over wildlife film, dark landscape imagery and satellite geography. Soft directional masks create reading space; open composition and tonal contrast do most of the grouping. Rich colour belongs to measured geographic fields and illustrated postage stamps.

The nightly ritual gives the stamps their meaning: an unnamed bird, an explicit after-dark action, real birds in flight, then a species reveal and its earned keepsake. Intact bird illustrations and licensed photographs sit within perforated paper, with optical finishes reserved for unlocked stamps. One continuous map and every profile remain open for independent discovery, with geographic shape and coverage derived from source records.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed imagery and geography with dissolving dark masks.
Large Geom headings; compact, unboxed navigation and controls.
Milky data fields, sealed paper stamps and tactile foil on earned keepsakes.
A mystery-to-reveal ritual, device-local earned stamps and action journals, visible sources and reduced-motion alternatives.

rules.name: The Evidence Colour Rule
rules.body: Both fields use fixed 0%, 5%, 10%+ colour. Tracking counts distinct individuals in the selected period; observation heat uses the selected species’ full-period record count even when months change. Neither estimates abundance, and observations do not establish routes.

rules.name: The Material Boundary Rule
rules.body: Keep foil and diffraction within an unlocked stamp’s illustration alpha mask or perforated paper silhouette. Sealed stamps, navigation and ordinary controls stay quiet and matte.

dos: Do preserve the locally bundled Geom face, oversized headings and generous open space.
Do keep terrain, geographic labels, legends and attribution legible beneath and around the density field.
Do derive visible coverage, dates and sample counts from the selected real records.
Do preserve perforated stamp edges and keep revealed identity, photography and printed artwork readable through each unlocked finish.
Do retain visible focus, native keyboard controls, pause controls and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep map context intact across the bird, collection and night-action journey.
Do preserve the same map, bird chooser and month control when moving between historical journeys and nearby observations.
Do keep living footage visible, its identity limits legible, and flight playback optional after recording.
Do keep the nightly bird concealed until action and film/reveal, and connect each earned stamp to its recorded night.
Do make location requests explicit and label local seasonal inspiration separately from global discovery.
Do preserve old bookmarks and journal entries without inventing rewards.
donts: Don't replace the cinematic world with boxed dashboard panels or pervasive hard dividers.
Don't turn UI headings into serif type; fine print embedded in stamp artwork is a separate material.
Don't label historical samples live, join independent observations into routes, or read brightness as abundance.
Don't invent routes or flowing particles to match a mockup, or crossfade data across a changed geographic frame.
Don't let a bookmark, old quiz flag, finish change or film replay unlock a stamp or reroll the nightly bird.
Don't interpret a Lights Out journal entry as sensor evidence, a bird-presence forecast or a measured conservation outcome.
